presets.name: Dolly In
presets.promptText: slow cinematic dolly in, camera physically moves toward the subject on a track, shallow depth of field

presets.name: Dolly Out
presets.promptText: smooth dolly out, camera pulls away from subject revealing the environment

presets.name: Crash Zoom
presets.promptText: aggressive crash zoom-in on the subject, fast snap zoom, high energy

presets.name: Push In
presets.promptText: slow push-in, lens zooms toward subject while camera position stays fixed

presets.name: 360 Orbit
presets.promptText: camera orbits 360 degrees around the subject at constant height, smooth circular motion

presets.name: Half Orbit
presets.promptText: camera arcs 180 degrees around the subject, cinematic parallax

presets.name: Crane Up
presets.promptText: crane shot rising upward while tilting down to keep subject framed, epic reveal

presets.name: Crane Down
presets.promptText: crane descends from high angle to eye level with the subject

presets.name: Pan Left
presets.promptText: smooth horizontal pan to the left across the scene

presets.name: Pan Right
presets.promptText: smooth horizontal pan to the right across the scene

presets.name: Tilt Up
presets.promptText: camera tilts upward from ground level, revealing the full subject

presets.name: Tracking Shot
presets.promptText: lateral tracking shot following the subject in motion, steady speed

presets.name: Follow Cam
presets.promptText: camera follows behind the subject, steadicam feel, immersive movement

presets.name: FPV Drone
presets.promptText: fast FPV drone shot weaving through the environment, dynamic banking turns

presets.name: Aerial Rise
presets.promptText: drone rises vertically revealing an aerial wide view of the location

presets.name: Bullet Time
presets.promptText: bullet time effect, subject frozen mid-action while camera sweeps around

presets.name: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo)
presets.promptText: dolly zoom vertigo effect, background warps while subject stays same size

presets.name: Handheld
presets.promptText: handheld camera, subtle natural shake, documentary realism

presets.name: Low Angle Hero
presets.promptText: static low-angle hero shot looking up at the subject, dramatic perspective

presets.name: Top-Down
presets.promptText: top-down overhead shot looking straight down at the scene

presets.name: Whip Pan
presets.promptText: fast whip pan transition with motion blur

presets.name: Snorricam
presets.promptText: snorricam rigged to the subject, background moves while face stays locked

presets.name: Bolt Cam
presets.promptText: high-speed robotic bolt camera move, extreme speed ramp toward the subject

presets.name: Locked Off
presets.promptText: static locked-off tripod shot, perfectly still frame
